****_The Flash_ #759**** is an issue of the series [_The Flash _ (Volume  1)](/wiki/The_Flash_Vol_1 "The Flash Vol 1") with a cover date of [ October, 2020](/wiki/Category:2020,_October "Category:2020, October"). It was published on August 11, 2020.
